description: Every simultaneous substitution instance of a propositional tautology is a tautology.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.subst_tautology.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v}
  (σ : α → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula β) (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)
  (hA : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Tautology A) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Tautology (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.subst σ A)
